title: P15.9-B5.3: /app/missions* Mission Operations + Task Entry + Mission Detail (canonical reads)
description: P15.9-B5.3 R1 — audit fixes. F1: objective backlink requires the full canonical chain — mission.bound_open_id is a work_open_binding.open_id (never an objective_id); backlink renders only when bound_open_id === server-stamped metadata.work_item_open_id AND metadata.work_item_id resolves via the scoped GET /api/work-items?business_id read to a row with a real objective_id; otherwise omitted + documented. F2: preview epoch/input pinning — invalidate() bumps the generation; late responses for previous inputs ignored; auto-confirm toggle-off mid-flight renders manual preview, never commits; commit() re-verifies pinned inputs before POST. F3: tasks/executions/approvals_pending validated as collections (non-array/invalid elements → MALFORMED per-section, never fake-empty); preview tasks require task_key + array-typed capabilities/depends_on before confirmable. F4: mission-id switch bumps mutation/file generations — results for A never land on B; deterministic intercepted-RUNNING lifecycle-failure test added. UI-only; no backend/schema/dependency changes.
